Scene Director 3.9.0-beta.2 — a Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized test app for **Apple Silicon (M1 or newer), macOS 13+**.

Download **Scene_Director_3.9.0-beta.2_macOS_arm64.zip**, extract it, then move **Scene Director.app** to Applications, replacing the previous test app. Settings and saved work are stored separately.

The input and output columns now both grow when you enlarge the window. Prompt Studio uses the full window width, with a proportional split between the brief and the prompt page. The header, navigation and LoRA Dataset follow the same window width; the dataset sidebar also grows with its workspace. Small windows retain the stacked layout. Text stays at its normal readable size; use View > Zoom In to enlarge the interface text.

Includes all features and review fixes from 3.9.0-beta.1. Python is bundled; a compatible language-model server is still required. Vision workflows require a vision-capable model.

The app and nested native code use Developer ID signing and hardened runtime, with a stapled Apple notarization ticket. The build checks signatures, Gatekeeper, portable HTTPS roots, bundled-service tests and native-window startup before and after extracting the archive. The attached **.signing.json** report identifies the source commit and ZIP checksum; **.sha256** verifies the download.

Source: the `scene-director-3.9` branch and [PR #1](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/Scene-Director/pull/1). Private prerelease. Layout checked in Electron at narrow, regular and large window sizes. Source checks use mock model services; live-model quality, real ComfyUI workflows and older supported macOS versions have not been evaluated for this test.
